reference_description: Fixed contender reference: SP+ +20 points; Elo 1625 for missing SP+ opponents or Elo comparison. Both are explicit modelling choices, fixed across scenarios, not re-estimated from user picks.
near_tie_description: Natural log(1.01): tail probabilities within 1% of the anchored group leader are near ties. A configurable policy choice, not a fitted coefficient. SOS then within-group head-to-head win differential, power, stable ID.
independence: Reference-team games independent conditional on fixed opponent ratings.
